# Algolia Website Indexer

The Apify actor [`apify/algolia-website-indexer`](https://apify.com/apify/algolia-website-indexer) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.20**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

The Indexer crawls recursively a website using the Puppeteer browser (headless Chrome) and indexes the selected pages to the Algolia index.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/algolia-website-indexer) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-algolia-website-indexer@0.0.20#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      algoliaAppId: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `algoliaAppId` | string | yes |  | Algolia App ID — Your Algolia Application ID |
| `algoliaApiKey` | string | yes |  | Algolia API Key — Your Algolia API key |
| `algoliaIndexName` | string | yes |  | Algolia Index Name — Your Algolia index name |
| `crawlerName` | string |  |  | Crawler Name — Crawler name, it updates/removes/adds pages into to index regarding this name. In this case, you can have more website in the index. |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Start URLs — URLs where to start crawling |
| `selectors` | array |  |  | Selectors — Pick selectors, which text content you want to index. Key is name of attribute and value is CSS selector. |
| `requiredAttributes` | array |  |  | Required attributes — Pick attributes, which are required in index. By default all attributes from selectors are required. |
| `waitForElement` | string |  |  | Wait for element — Selector of element to wait on each page. |
| `additionalPageAttrs` | object |  | `{}` | Additional attributes — Pick additional attributes you want to attach to each record in index. |
| `skipIndexUpdate` | boolean |  | `true` | Skip Index Updated — If check crawler will not update Algolia index. |
| `pseudoUrls` | array |  |  | Pseudo-URLs — Overrides default pseudoUrls |
| `pageFunction` | string |  |  | Page function — Overrides default pageFunction |
| `clickableElements` | string |  |  | Clickable elements — Overrides default clickableElements |
| `keepUrlFragments` | boolean |  | `false` | Keep URL fragments — Option to switch on enqueueing URL with URL fragments |
| `omitSearchParamsFromUrl` | boolean |  | `false` | Omit search params from URLs — Option to switch off enqueueing with search params. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
